description.raw: '''Passive:''' Scoring a champion [[File:Damage rating.png|20px|link=Takedown|An icon representing the keyword Takedown]] [[:Takedown|takedown]] reduces the '''current''' cooldowns of '''Master Yi's''' basic [[Champion ability|abilities]] by 70%.
description.text: Passive: Scoring a champion takedown reduces the current cooldowns of Master Yi's basic abilities by 70%.

description2.raw: '''Active:''' '''Master Yi''' [[File:Remove Scurvy.png|20px|link=Crowd control#Removal|An icon representing the keyword Cleanse]] [[:Crowd control#Removal|cleanses]] himself from all [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slows]] and [[File:Cripple icon.png|20px|link=Cripple|An icon representing the keyword Cripple]] [[:Cripple|cripples]]. For the next 7 seconds, he gains [[File:Ghost.png|20px|link=Unit collision|An icon representing the keyword Ghosted]] [[:Unit collision|ghosting]], [[File:Attack speed icon.png|15px|link=Attack speed]] '''bonus''' attack speed, [[File:Movement speed icon.png|15px|link=Movement speed]] '''bonus''' movement speed, [[File:Slow immune 2.png|20px|link=Slow_resist#Slow Immunity|An icon representing the keyword Slow-immune]] [[:Slow_resist#Slow Immunity|slow immunity]], and [[File:Cripple immune.png|20px|link=Slow_resist#Cripple Immunity|An icon representing the keyword Cripple-immune]] [[:Slow_resist#Cripple Immunity|cripple immunity]].
description2.text: Active: Master Yi cleanses himself from all slows and cripples. For the next 7 seconds, he gains ghosting,  bonus attack speed,  bonus movement speed, slow immunity, and cripple immunity.

description3.raw: While active, scoring a champion [[File:Damage rating.png|20px|link=Takedown|An icon representing the keyword Takedown]] [[:Takedown|takedown]] extends ''Highlander's'' duration by 7 seconds.
description3.text: While active, scoring a champion takedown extends Highlander's duration by 7 seconds.
